parts.headline: The Seller Holds the Paper
parts.question: How much of the money buying AI chips was lent, guaranteed or invested by the companies selling them?

call.stance: The seller finances part of the demand
call.line: Nvidia's receivables ran 9% to 16% of sales above its own collection pace by July 26, 2026; five accounts owed 70% of them.
actions: Compute days outstanding yourself on November 18: receivables over the quarter's revenue, times 91. July 26, 2026 gave 59.6.
Split Nvidia's $108.5 billion of guarantees by when they bind: $105 billion for SB Energy phases in from fiscal 2029; $3.5 billion is live.
Read Broadcom's $29B backstop and the $42B note facility in its Aug 2 10-Q, which Reuters ties to Anthropic, before its Dec 9 report.
flips: Nvidia's 10-Q for the quarter to Oct 25, 2026 puts days outstanding below 51.1, the average before July: the second quarter was a peak.
Free cash flow tops 71% of net income on Nov 18, its average in the four quarters before July: the cash came in and the terms were timing.
AMD or Broadcom reports a gigawatt-scale accelerator deal with no warrant, investment, loan or guarantee by Dec 9: demand pays its own way.
